pdf_script = '''
from docx import Document
from fpdf import FPDF
import re

doc = Document("docs/customer_report.docx")

pdf = FPDF()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)
pdf.add_page()

def add_heading(pdf, text, level):
    sizes = {0: 22, 1: 16, 2: 14}
    size = sizes.get(level, 12)
    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", size)
    if level == 0:
        pdf.cell(0, 12, text, ln=True, align="C")
    else:
        pdf.cell(0, 10, text, ln=True)
    pdf.ln(2)

def add_table(pdf, table):
    num_cols = len(table.columns)
    col_width = (pdf.w - 2 * pdf.l_margin) / num_cols
    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 10)
    # Header row
    for cell in table.rows[0].cells:
        pdf.cell(col_width, 8, cell.text, border=1, align="C")
    pdf.ln()
    # Data rows
    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
    for row in table.rows[1:]:
        for cell in row.cells:
            pdf.cell(col_width, 8, cell.text, border=1, align="C")
        pdf.ln()
    pdf.ln(4)

table_index = 0
tables = doc.tables

for element in doc.element.body:
    tag = element.tag.split("}")[-1] if "}" in element.tag else element.tag
    if tag == "p":
        from docx.oxml.ns import qn
        pPr = element.find(qn("w:pPr"))
        pStyle = None
        if pPr is not None:
            pStyleEl = pPr.find(qn("w:pStyle"))
            if pStyleEl is not None:
                pStyle = pStyleEl.get(qn("w:val"))

        text = "".join(node.text or "" for node in element.iter() if node.text)
        text = text.strip()

        if not text:
            pdf.ln(3)
            continue

        if pStyle and "Heading" in pStyle:
            # Extract level number
            level_match = re.search(r"(\\d+)", pStyle)
            level = int(level_match.group(1)) if level_match else 1
            # Title style maps to level 0
            if "Title" in pStyle:
                level = 0
            add_heading(pdf, text, level)
        else:
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 11)
            pdf.multi_cell(0, 6, text)
            pdf.ln(2)

    elif tag == "tbl":
        if table_index < len(tables):
            add_table(pdf, tables[table_index])
            table_index += 1

pdf.output("docs/customer_report.pdf")
print("PDF created successfully at docs/customer_report.pdf")
'''
await write_file("./convert_to_pdf.py", pdf_script)

email_script = '''
import smtplib
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email import encoders
import os

msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg["From"] = "agent@cuga.dev"
msg["To"] = "bob@example.com"
msg["Subject"] = "Customer Activity Report - Maya Chen"

body = """Dear Bob,

Please find attached the Customer Activity Report for Maya Chen.

Report highlights:
- Customer: Maya Chen
- Order: ORD-6C71B1
- Order Date: 2026-09-02
- Total: $79.00

Best regards,
Cuga Agent"""

msg.attach(MIMEText(body, "plain"))

pdf_path = "docs/customer_report.pdf"
with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
    part = MIMEBase("application", "octet-stream")
    part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header("Content-Disposition", f"attachment; filename=customer_report.pdf")
    msg.attach(part)

try:
    server = smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25)
    server.sendmail(msg["From"], [msg["To"]], msg.as_string())
    server.quit()
    print("Email sent successfully to bob@example.com")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"SMTP localhost failed: {e}")
    try:
        server = smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 1025)
        server.sendmail(msg["From"], [msg["To"]], msg.as_string())
        server.quit()
        print("Email sent successfully to bob@example.com (port 1025)")
    except Exception as e2:
        print(f"SMTP localhost:1025 also failed: {e2}")
        # Save the .eml file as fallback
        eml_path = "docs/customer_report.eml"
        with open(eml_path, "w") as ef:
            ef.write(msg.as_string())
        print(f"Email saved as .eml file at {eml_path} (no SMTP server available)")
'''
